verdict.rationale: The only recurring automation in the evidence is a Xero integration setting that automatically syncs invoices the day after each payroll is processed, plus automatic yearly holiday designation in time-off policies. These are fixed, built-in automations rather than user-defined scheduled jobs or workflows. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec that might expose programmatic scheduling. Missing for 10: a user-configurable scheduler for arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, cron-like or custom recurrence rules, API/agent-accessible scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
